digest.component_or_area: developer guidance and CI policy documentation
propositions: Flaky (intermittently failing) tests must be root-caused and fixed via /rebar-debug workflow, not retried until they pass.

The recheck comment is reserved for provably environmental faults (TLS cert, runner outage, CI dispatch failure) with reasoning stated; nondeterministic test failures are bugs, not recheck candidates.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md §6 currently contradict each other on whether transient-looking failures warrant recheck, creating a self-contradicting guidance that licenses retry-until-green.
Documentation must be reconciled so both files state the rule consistently, cross-link rather than duplicate, and eliminate the old retry-until-green licence.
A flaky pipeline slows development, wastes tokens, and erodes CI as a regression oracle; one root-cause session is cheaper than iterative recheck cycles.
